answer: Force every identity through one narrow canyon checkpoint before it can trade: a single-file gate where admission demands a walnut-hard proof of unique, sustained effort - a task that takes real time and cannot be parallelised across clones. Behind the gate, a willow grove of independent verifiers, each with different methods, must agree the newcomer is genuine; one compromised checker cannot open the pass alone. A sybil farmer can breed thousands of names, but cannot squeeze thousands of distinct, time-locked proofs through one canyon while willow verifiers watch every crossing.
